title: Result Envelope
summary: Pack large tool results into summaries, schemas, and stable pages.
user: MCP and CLI tool authors who need to return large structured results to models without silently truncating, over-tokenizing, or hiding the useful rows.
smallest_useful_product: An npm library and CLI that turns rows or JSON into a manifest, compact summary, schema, stable page cursors, and optional streamed chunks; it includes a local inspector.
constraints: Preserve types and provenance; enforce configurable row and byte caps; avoid embedding sensitive sample rows in telemetry.
